criteria.name: Complete written scope
criteria.requirement: All eight fixed paragraphs, every raw group/separator/entity/uncertainty and every ZL/IT/RF alternative are retained. ZL/IT native boundaries remain source metadata; RF literal0/0 does not become native paragraph evidence. Missing pairs and negative source flags remain visible. No extra earlier paragraph or outside body is imported.

criteria.name: Finite paid meanings
criteria.requirement: A single finite C0 dictionary/grammar declares every whole/part value, changed inherited hypothesis, production, macro substep, default, type lift, initial binding and stage policy before application. Confirmed anchors are not required. Opaque material names require a fixed nominal frame and a price; arbitrary unknown/control groups do not become opaque nouns without a declared analysis.

criteria.name: Earlier written Plan producer
criteria.requirement: The earlier paragraph must supply identified written steps, formal input slots, selected operation order and a closure/completion convention producing a Plan. Give source IDs for each. A preloaded Plan or named MaterialSpec is insufficient. An attached-protocol lift requires its own declared/costed production and provenance.

criteria.name: Fixed retrieval and stage scope
criteria.requirement: One global reference/stage-selector policy chooses the earlier written Plan or a written stage scope. Record compatible candidates, publication/completion boundaries and any consumption rule. Resolve without knowing eventual truth or convenient output. Ambiguous full/stage scope, competing Plans or unread closure remains an explicit barrier, not per-application action picking.

criteria.name: Current written input
criteria.requirement: Identify the current paragraph written input and type/instance IDs. Invocation takes that input, not the earlier output or copied ingredient list. Distinguish formal substituted roles from captured constants, including their source IDs. Current material ancestry is not a global lexical replacement of earlier materials.

criteria.name: New invocation and derived output
criteria.requirement: Show substitution into only the declared formal slots, preservation of selected operation order, fresh Execution/Event/Output identities and input/output ancestry. No hidden execution, reset, transport, new portion or implicit result is supplied after a failure. A call is distinct from merely retrieving an old material/result.

criteria.name: Actual output consumers
criteria.requirement: At least one later written consumer must use the call-generated output or event, with exact source IDs, typed argument position and provenance. Supply every claimed consumer; two claimed uses require two distinct traceable uses. A compatible ambient register or a second paraphrase does not establish the required return-value dependency.

criteria.name: Instruction and outcome layers
criteria.requirement: Keep description, assertion, instruction, goal, execution in the hypothetical program, textual outcome claim and externally observed result distinct. Required output identity/type can be authored; actual physical efficacy, clinical result or achieved goal is not observed here. A claimed observation predicate is itself a paid reading unless independently bound.

criteria.name: UNKNOWN and source-specific barriers
criteria.requirement: Preserve uncertain letters/spaces, reader-specific cuts, negative pair alternatives and native boundary disagreement without autocorrection or consensus. Stop only dependent claims at the first relevant unknown/control barrier; retain all later raw groups and separately available obligations. RF external windows permit explicit exploratory traces, not native whole-paragraph confirmation.

criteria.name: Freeze and literal transfer
criteria.requirement: Freeze one whole candidate, full derivations, scope, criterion interpretations and per-application predictions before additional bodies open. Both independent candidates must freeze or explicitly freeze non-capacity. Apply unchanged rules to both complete additional pairs and all readers, reporting each separately. Discovery on physical leaf83 and all prior exposure supply zero independent meaning-confirmation capacity.

criteria.name: Full graph and rival comparison
criteria.requirement: Compare full Plan/call/output/reference graphs including source provenance, not only projected physical traces or prose. Name projections that erase wrapper/attachment differences. A separately paid material-with-attached-protocol rival may preserve the call trace; such equivalence leaves meaning unresolved. Enlarged FW prior paragraphs cannot repair FV or donate FV an unregistered prior role.

historical_source.source_layer: Institutional CoReMA annotated TEI / scholarly transcription; no new native-image claim
refused_inference: source identity or automatic Voynich word assignment
historical_source.source_owned_contrast: Black coating current material differs from earlier green coating material; as-before is written, but exact inherited stage scope remains unresolved. FV source conditional material choice is a separate function.
historical_source.target_requirement: A target earlier written Plan/current-input/new-output/consumer chain must be supplied by its own complete paid analysis, not transferred from chicken source.
